voice.name: Bill - Wise, Mature, Balanced
voice.why: The quartermaster has kept the camp's crate and count for years: older, measured, a man who has said no to better people than you. Bill is a crisp, mature American voice, nothing like the buyer's husky patter or the gate guard's young bark, and no other speaker uses this voice.

greet.text: Quartermaster. I keep the crate and I keep the count. Nothing leaves this camp without a price on it.

stock.text: A radio, a pistol, a rifle. The crate shows what I will sell you today. The longer people have known you, the more of it I will show.

refuse.text: We don't deal with the law here. Take the badge off and come back.

replies.badge: I'm on duty. I'd like to buy.
